scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/client" "npm run dev -w packages/server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/client && npm run lint -w packages/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/client && npm run typecheck -w packages/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/server && npm run test -w packages/client
